rejectionVerdictOn47A3RRow.reason: Article 214 establishes High Courts as distinct constitutional entities for each State or shared between specific States. Subordinate judiciary recruitment is conducted either by the respective State PSC or directly by the designated High Court under state-specific judicial service rules. No generic national 'High Courts' authority exists.
